theorems.name: Submission.p02_es_177ebb5a_pnf_primitive_kernel
theorems.statement: ∀ M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ, M.det = 0 → ∃ p q : ℤ, IsCoprime p q ∧ M.mulVec ![p, q] = 0
theorems.natural_summary: For the zero matrix choose (1,0). Otherwise, a vector perpendicular to a nonzero row is nonzero and lies in the kernel because the determinant vanishes. Divide its coordinates by their positive gcd to obtain coprime integers, then cancel that gcd in both kernel equations.
